description.value: Sunwolf Riverside Resort offers 13 contemporary riverside cabins nestled in old-growth forest halfway between Vancouver and Whistler, making it a natural stop on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor. The property includes Fergie's Cafe, an on-site brunch restaurant that has won Best Breakfast from locals every year since 2015, drawing on locally sourced ingredients. The resort is family-owned, pet-friendly, and holds a Sustainable Tourism Certification.

address.value: 70002 Squamish Valley Rd, PO Box 244, Brackendale, BC V0N 1H0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is operational as a 13-cabin riverside resort with an on-site cafe (Fergie's, open daily for brunch), located at 70002 Squamish Valley Rd in Brackendale. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched content. A notable name discrepancy exists: OSM records the business as 'Sunwolf Cabins and Rafting' while the website consistently brands it as 'Sunwolf Riverside Resort,' and rafting is not referenced anywhere on the current site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Sunwolf Cabins and Rafting' but the business currently operates and brands itself as 'Sunwolf Riverside Resort' across all website content.
Rafting services referenced in the OSM name are entirely absent from the current website, suggesting the business has rebranded or discontinued that offering.
OSM record had no address or phone; values above were sourced from the website and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Strong location on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor with on-site food makes this a potentially valuable WWC listing, but neither secure bike storage nor any other required cycling amenity is mentioned on the website — direct outreach is needed to confirm before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Fergie's Cafe is described as open daily for brunch only; no evidence of dinner service on-site. The resort notes a Sustainable Tourism Certification. Toll-free number is 1-844-898-1537; local number is 604-898-1537.
